name: ecommerce
description: E-commerce storefront archetype with catalog, product detail, cart and order workflow.
journeys: browse -> search/filter -> product detail -> add to cart
guidelines: Do not represent unavailable inventory as purchasable.
Keep cart and checkout state explicit and recoverable.
definition_of_done: Catalog and product detail are usable and responsive.
A user can complete an order flow and view order history.
